name: Anamorph
description: An anamorphic stretch: the distortion grows across the sheet until the shape is unreadable.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 50%; -webkit-transform: scaleX(@calc(0.2 + 1.3 * @x / @X)) skewX(@calc(30 - 60 * @x / @X)deg); transform: scaleX(@calc(0.2 + 1.3 * @x / @X)) skewX(@calc(30 - 60 * @x / @X)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
